result.brief: 提出免训练的去噪一致性KV缓存剪枝方法，用于自回归视频扩散，大幅降低历史缓存并加速长视频续写，同时发布长上下文评测基准CMBench。
result.reason: Training-free KV-cache pruning for autoregressive video diffusion using denoising consistency; enables long-horizon streaming video generation and a long-context benchmark, directly serving video generation efficiency.
